name: chromium-surfaces-duplicate-started
prompt: `crates/surface-input/src/touch.rs` tracks live fingers and normalises platform touch events. A second `Started` event for a finger id that is already live is currently forwarded as another `Started`, so a client that counts downs sees two downs for one finger. Change `Touches::observe` so a duplicate `Started` is delivered as `Moved` — the finger is still down, and the new position is kept — and add a regression test asserting that a live finger never produces two `Started` events. Run `cargo test -p surface-input` and `cargo fmt --all`.
